metadata.title: Retro Soul Portrait with Floral Accent

recipe.visualDefinition: A highly stylized, airbrushed portrait of a woman with warm, glowing skin tones centered against a solid deep purple background. She features dark, voluminous hair adorned with vibrant pink tropical flowers on one side, and the composition is topped with a neon-pink cursive script in the upper right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm skin tones contrasting against a cool, saturated purple field
Symmetrical facial features balanced by asymmetrical floral hair accents
Soft airbrushed gradients meeting sharp, dark eyeliner and lash definition
Neon pink typography echoing the hue of the floral hair arrangement
coreInvariants: High-contrast black eyeliner and defined eyebrows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale head and shoulders portrait, centered horizontally, occupying the bottom two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, rendered with high contrast and sharp detail.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down to the red lips, up to the pink flowers, and finally to the script in the top right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample flat purple space surrounding the head, particularly in the top third.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Magenta and Neon Pink (Flowers and Text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout; the dark hair provides a value anchor while the skin and flowers provide high-value highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain high saturation in the purple and pinks

letterConstructionRules: Connected lowercase letters with high-looping ascenders
Double-lined or outlined effect for a neon-like glow
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters feature exaggerated, rounded flourishes
Descenders are short and tucked close to the baseline
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single script style to maintain focus on the portrait.
graphicDevices: Organic floral cluster as a framing element

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the thin, glowing line quality

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a centered airbrushed portrait of a woman with 1970s glamour makeup, dark voluminous hair, and a cluster of pink hibiscus flowers on the right side of her hair, set against a solid deep purple background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom cursive script in the top right corner using a neon pink monoline stroke, angled slightly upward, ensuring it does not overlap the hair.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, vibrant purple?
Are the skin tones warm and luminous?
Is the text in the top right corner angled and pink?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text artifacts appear on the face
Check that the hair volume is symmetrical except for the flowers
Verify the neon glow effect on the typography
Confirm the eyes have a sharp, 'painted' catchlight
recipe.reuseFormula: Airbrushed Portrait + Solid Saturated Background + Floral Hair Accent + Corner Script Overlay
